methodology.recentForm: average fantasy points across latest 3 scored gameweeks, with missing player-weeks treated as zero
methodology.participationRate: appearances divided by distinct scored matches observed for the player current club
methodology.balancedTeam: deterministic local search from the exact maximum-points team; requires 2-4 top-decile adjusted-performance stars, at least 3 value-pick candidates, $95M-$100M, quotas and max 3 per club
